items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I went to work with Tony Bennett and also we toured the entire United States... I recorded with him a number of times too

ctx.x: Tell me about your relationship with Count Basie.

Well, with Count Basie - when I was working with Tony Bennett, it was in 1958 in Philadelphia at the Latin Casino in Philadelphia. Count Basie was the orchestra that accompanied Tony Bennett on that show. In that year I was working with Tony Bennett. This was how I met Count Basie personally but I had heard his records back in Cuba on the radio. I had heard him but I said, "I would love it if one day I have the luck to reach the United States, to meet all these great musicians there in person and hear them, know…
